title: Research: group C native residual widths under #2979 joint W (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded independent-moment audit under priority revision 6 for #2979 group C. Leave-alone [#3411](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3411) already binds group B residual pairs `0:260` / `114:260`; `research/rank7-group-a-entrance-audit/` binds group A pairs `0:261` / `115:261`.

This package binds group C helpers `{452,453,532,533}` under shared `W=⟨256,128,64,32,19,11,6⟩` on both providers and both orientations:

- all four helpers: residual pair `115:262`, entrance `[30]`, width **6**
- adapter and `LOCAL-CHECKS` hashes match retained `FULL-NATIVE-RECEIPT.json`
- widths join all **2664** T74 fill placements

**Scoped native/interface audit. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Guide margins `+17170` / single-helper negatives are deliberately not headlined (already in `#2979` `STAGE-PRICES.json`).

## Result

Package: `research/rank7-group-c-native-widths-audit/`.
Tip: `ad6350cbb8297ad9e99bf75cb62f27f73e00807a`.
Content tip: `82407e5bded3c213537ef443c8b9e64e2ee51573`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/rank7-group-c-native-widths-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/rank7-group-c-native-widths-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/rank7-group-c-native-widths-audit/test_verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-group-c-native-widths-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_GROUP_C_NATIVE_WIDTHS providers=2 helpers=4 residual_widths=6,6,6,6 pairs=452:115:262,453:115:262,532:115:262,533:115:262 placements=2664 adapter_pinned both_orientations no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/rank7-group-c-native-widths-audit outcome=partial
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` / `require()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3411](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3411) / group-A entrance (native method; different helpers/W/pairs); #2979 `research/rank7-joint-endframes/` @ `be191346…`. Does not reopen #3421, #3392, #3386, #3374, #3349, deferred V45 / rho=0 / group-B margins, or the merged readout series through #2883.
